name: Continuous Attenuation Model for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A volumetric ray-marching formulation equivalent to the rasterization-based image formation model of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It maps Gaussian primitives to a continuous attenuation field σ(x, w) to allow the application of theoretical results from OaV for surface extraction.
summary: The Continuous Attenuation Model reformulates 3D Gaussian Splatting into a volumetric ray-marching framework that prevents surface erosion and multi-view inconsistency by enforcing geometric constraints on the attenuation field.
